Requires Node 22.12 or newer. Run commands from backend.

1. Install dependencies:
   npm ci
2. Copy .env.example to .env if .env does not exist. Set MUSIC_DIRECTORY to your music folder.
   Relative music and MUSIC_DB_PATH paths resolve from backend, regardless of the shell directory.
3. Build the UI as described in ../ui/README.txt, or run its development server.
4. Start Treble:
   npm start

Development restart-on-change:
   npm run dev

The UI and API start using the cached library while the music folder is scanned
and its watcher initializes in the background. The UI updates when indexing finishes.
Cached library data stays available if the music folder is temporarily unreachable.
Existing music.db records keep their IDs while metadata columns are added and tags are refreshed.
Rescan music folder in the empty-library view waits for a scan to finish.
Audio files are never modified.
The music index is stored in MUSIC_DB_PATH. No database server is required.
Windows UNC music folders use polling every 30 seconds to detect changes.

Network access:
Leave HOST empty for all available interfaces, preserving IPv4, IPv6 and Tailscale access.
Set HOST to a particular Tailscale IP to bind only that interface, or to 127.0.0.1
for IPv4 localhost-only use. HOST=0.0.0.0 listens on all IPv4 interfaces.
PORT defaults to 4001. The built UI is available on that port.
The music API is for a personal trusted network and does not require sign-in.
Use your existing Tailscale access controls to choose which devices can reach it.
CORS_ORIGINS optionally restricts browser origins to a comma-separated list.
Leaving it empty preserves access from different personal-network browser origins.

Checks:
   npm test
   npm audit

Requires Node 22.22.2+, Node 24.15+, or Node 26+ for the development and test tools.
Run commands from ui.

1. Install dependencies:
   npm ci
2. Start the backend as described in ../backend/README.txt.
3. Start the UI:
   npm run dev

Open http://localhost:4000 or http://<Tailscale-IP>:4000.
The dev server accepts Tailscale .ts.net names and forwards /api to port 4001.
For a different backend port, set VITE_PROXY_TARGET in the shell before starting Vite.

Production:
   npm run build
The backend serves ui/dist together with /api on port 4001.
Open http://<Tailscale-IP>:4001 after building and starting the backend.
For separate UI hosting, proxy /api to the backend or set VITE_API_URL at build time.
Leave VITE_API_URL empty for same-origin hosting. Avoid localhost URLs when using another device.

Checks:
   npm test
   npm run build
   npm audit

Open Settings beside the search bar, then Theme to choose Turquoise Dreams,
Purple, Royalty or Dark. Themes apply immediately and are saved per browser.

Volume, shuffle and repeat are saved per browser. The active tab, folder/album,
search, scroll position, queue and paused playback position resume in the same tab.
Reload does not start playback automatically. Removed files fall out of the saved queue.

The search bar finds songs across the whole library by title, artist, album,
filename or folder path. Clear it or press Escape to return to the previous view
and scroll position. Playing a search result queues the matching songs in result
order. Editing or clearing the search leaves that playback queue intact.

Right-click a song, or use its options button, to go to its album, artist or
containing folder without changing playback. Untagged songs offer folder navigation.

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
import Settings from '../src/components/Settings.vue'
import { initializeTheme } from '../src/themes.js'

let wrapper

beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear()
    initializeTheme()
    wrapper = mount(Settings, { attachTo: document.body })
})

afterEach(() => {
    wrapper.unmount()
    document.body.replaceChildren()
    document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme')
})

describe('theme settings', () => {
    it('keeps Settings compact and applies a theme through the separate chooser', async () => {
        const trigger = wrapper.get('button[aria-label="Settings"]')
        expect(wrapper.find('[role="dialog"]').exists()).toBe(false)
        await trigger.trigger('click')
        expect(trigger.attributes('aria-expanded')).toBe('true')
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(wrapper.get('.theme-summary').element)
        expect(wrapper.get('.theme-summary').text()).toContain('Turquoise Dreams')
        expect(wrapper.find('[role="radiogroup"]').exists()).toBe(false)
        await wrapper.get('.theme-summary').trigger('click')
        const choices = wrapper.findAll('[role="radio"]')
        expect(choices.map(choice => choice.text())).toEqual(['Turquoise Dreams', 'Purple', 'Royalty', 'Dark'])
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(choices[0].element)
        await choices[2].trigger('click')
        expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe('royalty')
        expect(localStorage.getItem('Treble-Theme')).toBe('royalty')
        expect(wrapper.get('[aria-checked="true"]').text()).toBe('Royalty')
        await wrapper.get('[aria-label="Back to settings"]').trigger('click')
        expect(wrapper.find('[role="radiogroup"]').exists()).toBe(false)
        expect(wrapper.get('.theme-summary').text()).toContain('Royalty')
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(wrapper.get('.theme-summary').element)
        await wrapper.get('[aria-label="Close settings"]').trigger('click')
        await trigger.trigger('click')
        expect(wrapper.get('.theme-summary').text()).toContain('Royalty')
        await wrapper.get('.theme-summary').trigger('click')
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(wrapper.get('[aria-checked="true"]').element)
    })

    it('closes with Escape, Close and the icon, returning focus to the icon', async () => {
        const trigger = wrapper.get('button[aria-label="Settings"]')
        for (const action of ['escape', 'close', 'toggle']) {
            await trigger.trigger('click')
            if (action === 'escape') await wrapper.get('.theme-summary').trigger('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })
            else if (action === 'close') await wrapper.get('[aria-label="Close settings"]').trigger('click')
            else await trigger.trigger('click')
            expect(wrapper.find('[role="dialog"]').exists()).toBe(false)
            expect(trigger.attributes('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')
            expect(document.activeElement).toBe(trigger.element)
        }
    })

    it('returns from the chooser with Escape before closing Settings', async () => {
        await wrapper.get('.settings-trigger').trigger('click')
        await wrapper.get('.theme-summary').trigger('click')
        await wrapper.get('[aria-checked="true"]').trigger('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })
        expect(wrapper.get('h2').text()).toBe('Settings')
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(wrapper.get('.theme-summary').element)
        await wrapper.get('.theme-summary').trigger('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })
        expect(wrapper.find('[role="dialog"]').exists()).toBe(false)
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(wrapper.get('.settings-trigger').element)
    })

    it('supports radio keys, wraps at both ends and keeps the selected theme visible', async () => {
        await wrapper.get('.settings-trigger').trigger('click')
        await wrapper.get('.theme-summary').trigger('click')
        const choices = wrapper.findAll('[role="radio"]')
        const scroll = vi.fn()
        choices[3].element.scrollIntoView = scroll
        await choices[0].trigger('keydown', { key: 'End' })
        expect(wrapper.get('[aria-checked="true"]').text()).toBe('Dark')
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(choices[3].element)
        expect(scroll).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ block: 'nearest' })
        await choices[3].trigger('keydown', { key: 'ArrowRight' })
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(choices[0].element)
        await choices[0].trigger('keydown', { key: 'ArrowUp' })
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(choices[3].element)
        await choices[3].trigger('keydown', { key: 'Home' })
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(choices[0].element)
        expect(wrapper.findAll('[tabindex="0"]')).toHaveLength(1)
        expect(localStorage.getItem('Treble-Theme')).toBe('turquoise-dreams')
    })

    it('closes on an outside press or leaving with Tab without taking focus back', async () => {
        const outside = document.createElement('input')
        document.body.append(outside)
        await wrapper.get('.settings-trigger').trigger('click')
        await wrapper.get('.theme-summary').trigger('click')
        document.body.dispatchEvent(new Event('pointerdown', { bubbles: true }))
        await wrapper.vm.$nextTick()
        expect(wrapper.find('[role="dialog"]').exists()).toBe(false)
        await wrapper.get('.settings-trigger').trigger('click')
        expect(wrapper.get('.theme-summary').exists()).toBe(true)
        await wrapper.get('.theme-summary').trigger('click')
        outside.focus()
        await wrapper.vm.$nextTick()
        expect(wrapper.find('[role="dialog"]').exists()).toBe(false)
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(outside)
    })
})

import { createApp } from 'vue'
import App from './App.vue'
import './styles/normalize.css'
import './styles/main.css'
import { initializeTheme } from './themes'

initializeTheme()
createApp(App).mount('#app')

export const volumeLocalStorageKey = 'Treble-Volume'
export const shuffleLocalStorageKey = 'Treble-Shuffle'
export const repeatLocalStorageKey = 'Treble-Repeat'
